candidates.name: Nedbank Golf Challenge 2026
candidates.geography: Gary Player Country Club, Sun City, North West (550km from Randburg)
candidates.relevance_to_swing_shack: Africa's Major. Largest single week of SA golf. SA golfers + weekend warriors watch closely. Spikes fitting/coaching/trackman-demo content around the time.
candidates.opportunity: Watch-party + TrackMan iO demo of the winning player's club path. Fitting promo: 'Get fitted like the pros before the new season.' TrackMan commercial push on key holes.
candidates.why_it_matters: Same weekend as BFCM (2026-11-27 → 11-30). Two weeks later is Festive Gifting 2026-12-22. Crowded tail of year — careful not to dilute the spine spine items.
